subject: LynxAI SIG intake: Pre-call agenda & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@lynxai.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Romero <alex.romero@lynxai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LynxAI SIG intake - request to kick off and schedule

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick reply on the portal. We're starting a SIG + CAIQ review for potential integration with Redwood Inference and would like to schedule an intake call next week to align scope and owners. High-level ask:

- Walkthrough of Redwood's CAIQ answers and where evidence lives
- Confirm log retention & export samples (we need data-flow diagrams for our security team)
- Understand deployment modes (hosted vs. private) and any in-scope controls for SOC 2

I attached a short CAIQ template (filled out where we had initial questions). Could you confirm who from your side should attend? Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Attachments: lynxai_caiq_initial.xlsx

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Security Program Manager, LynxAI
Samira.K@lynxai.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lynxai.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LynxAI SIG intake - request to kick off and schedule

Hi Samira — great to meet you. Thanks for the CAIQ file, that helps a lot. We can do Tue or Wed morning PST; I penciled Tue 2026-08-18 10:00am PST but happy to move if that doesn't work.

Planned attendees from Redwood:
- Olga Petrov (Security & Compliance) — CAIQ / evidence owner
- David Kim (Platform Ops) — logs & retention, production access patterns
- Jasmine Liu (Product Security) — architecture and integration controls

Pre-call asks (so we can prepare artifacts):
1) A short list of highest-priority CAIQ sections you want to review live (e.g., Logging, Data Residency, Access Controls).
2) Any in-scope environments (production only vs. staging).
3) Names and emails for additional reviewers (legal/procurement) if you expect contract talk.

We can share a runbook with sample artifacts ahead of the call (log export sample, minimal redacted traces, and our CAIQ mapping). I'll attach the runbook and a manifest of files we'll drop into a shared Drive.

Proposed agenda (15–30m):
- Intro & goals (5m)
- CAIQ walkthrough & live Q&A on 6 highlighted controls (10–15m)
- Evidence handoff plan & timeline (5–10m)
- Next steps & owners (5m)

I'll attach the runbook and a short checklist. Please confirm Tue 8/18 10am PST or propose alternatives.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: sample_access_instructions.txt, request_log_manifest.csv

From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@lynxai.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, samira.k@lynxai.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LynxAI SIG intake - request to kick off and schedule

Thanks Olga — Tue 10am PST works for Samira and me. A couple quick clarifications before the call so we can scope reviewers: 

- For logs: can you provide a sample export (redacted) showing request/response headers, timestamps, and region tag? We need to validate retention windows and whether KMS/HSM metadata is present.
- For CAIQ: we flagged a few CAIQ items around key management and separation of duties. If you can pre-mark those in the CAIQ mapping that would save time.
- For deployment modes: we expect to discuss a private/VPC option — can you indicate the typical lead time for a Private deployment and whether license/support differs?

Also copying our security contact group: LynxAI Security <security@lynxai.com> — they may open a separate evidence request after the call.

Attachments: (none)

Cheers,
Alex Romero
Senior Engineer, Integrations
Alex.Romero@lynxai.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lynxai.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@lynxai.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LynxAI SIG intake - request to kick off and schedule

Great — confirmed: Tue, Aug 18 2026 10:00 AM PST (30 min) — Meet link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-lynxai-redwood

Actions we've taken / items we'll drop into the shared Drive before the call (owned):
- Olga: CAIQ mapping (we will mark KMS / key-management related controls) — drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF-ghI
- David: Redacted log export sample + manifest (request_log_manifest.csv) — includes timestamps, region tags, header views (PII redacted).
- Jasmine: Architecture diagram + integration notes (how token exchange and deployment modes separate control plane and data plane).

Pre-call checklist for LynxAI (please reply if anything else):
- Confirm whether you want staging logs included or production-only (we recommend production-only unless you need end-to-end test traces).
- Provide email(s) for anyone from procurement/legal who should be looped after intake.
- Note any CAIQ rows flagged as high priority so we can pre-annotate answers.

Attachments we will upload prior to the call: lynxai_caiq_initial.xlsx (your copy with our notes), sample_access_instructions.txt, request_log_manifest.csv

If all good I will share the Drive folder with view-only links and a short runbook describing how to request additional artifacts post-call. Looking forward to the conversation.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192
